Meta.description: Uruguayan beef and lamb exporter. Demo website of a fictitious company.

hero.title: Uruguayan beef and lamb for the world
hero.lead: We process up to {cattle} cattle and {sheep} sheep per day and export to more than {countries} countries, with individual traceability for every animal.
hero.imageAlt: Angus and Hereford cattle on pasture at sunset

buyers.title: Buyers and importers
buyers.text: Chilled and frozen beef and lamb cuts, with the approvals required by the most demanding markets.
buyers.benefit1: Bone-in and boneless cuts, chilled or frozen
buyers.benefit2: Approved for China, the United States, the European Union and Israel
buyers.benefit3: Individual traceability from farm to container
buyers.imageAlt: Container ship at sea, seen from above

producers.title: Livestock producers
producers.text: We buy steers, heifers, cows and sheep nationwide, dealing directly with you and paying on time.
producers.benefit2: Livestock buyers who travel to your area
producers.benefit3: Clear settlement, with yield and grading for every animal
producers.whatsappMessage: [Demo] Hello, I'd like to offer livestock to the plant.
producers.imageAlt: Herd of Hereford cattle in the field

origin.eyebrow: From Sarandí del Yí to the world
origin.title: More than five decades in the heart of Uruguay's cattle country
origin.p1: Since {founded}, the {family} family has processed pasture-raised livestock from the centre of the country. The plant, on Route 6 just outside Sarandí del Yí, covers {hectares} hectares and employs {employees} people from the area.
origin.p2: Every animal arrives identified through the national individual traceability system, and every box that leaves the plant can be traced back to the farm where it was raised.
origin.imageAlt: Cattle resting on a rolling natural grassland

prices.title: Reference price board
prices.lead: Indicative purchase prices in US dollars per kilo of carcass weight, updated every Monday.
prices.unavailable: The price board is not available right now.

Products.metaDescription: Catalogue of export beef and lamb cuts, chilled and frozen, bone-in and boneless. Filter by area, market and presentation.
Products.title: Beef and lamb cuts
Products.lead: Choose an area of the animal or use the filters. Each cut shows its presentations, whether it is bone-in or boneless, and its main markets.

specs.title: Presentations and carton format
specs.chilled: Vacuum-packed and kept between {min} and {max} °C. Shelf life of up to {beef} days for beef and {lamb} days for lamb. Cartons of {boxMin} to {boxMax} kg.
specs.frozen: Vacuum-packed and frozen at {min} °C or below. Shelf life of up to {months} months. Cartons of {boxMin} to {boxMax} kg.
specs.note: Reference data. Every order is adjusted to the customer's specification sheet.

detail.quoteText: Tell us the volume, presentation and destination, and a sales executive will reply with price and availability.
